title: Source, target and current-map names in the saturation back step need local correction.
details: Schlicht, An Introduction to Model Theory, PDF revised2021-07-13, Lemma4.2.3 printed p.23. The range step writes a type in M for the requested point b_j and parameters B_j belonging to N; this should be a type in N. Its chosen witness a must belong to M rather than N, and its old parameter domain is A_j together with the just-requested a_j, not the new witness a. The pullback must use the inverse of the current extended map f'_j, whose range includes the newly added point, rather than the prior f_j. These are local source/target/index corrections; the standard saturation argument and the stated theorem remain valid. The preliminary assertion that intermediate domains are finite needs cardinality less than kappa at transfinite stages in the general-cardinal version; our countable specialization keeps them finite throughout. The corpus explicitly extends the inverse of the current map at the prescribed next target point. No failure of the general theorem is claimed.
